title: Compiler switch exposes an unused private field
root_cause: The runner image version changed and its default C++ compiler switched from GCC to Clang. Clang reports an unused private field under the existing warning flags, and -Werror turns that diagnostic into a build failure; the intervening project version change does not affect compilation.

relevant_evidence.why: CMake identifies the default C++ compiler as Clang 19.
Clang rejects the unused private field because warnings are errors.
The class declares the unused field.
